card.title: Poco X3 Pro No Touch (common fault)

source.title: Poco X3 Pro No Touch (common fault)

claims.statement: Poco X3 Pro no touch after drops or careless repair usually has damaged TOUCH_SPI lines; they read about 0.500–0.700 in diode mode.
A missing 20 Ω resistor on these lines can be jumpered; a missing 1 kΩ one must be replaced.

procedure: Replace missing 1 kΩ resistors; jumper missing 20 Ω ones.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
